digest.component_or_area: Test infrastructure: subprocess and network reliability sentinels
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted consumes 15 seconds with production 10-second low-speed window and 15-second loopback server; test contract is sustained throughput above floor across one complete window, not elapsed time

test_read_retried_then_terminal launches three real child processes with one-second call timeout and production 2s/4s retry backoff sleeps, consuming ~9 seconds total; test contract is exactly three attempts, exact retry schedule, terminal timeout, and no surviving process group

Injecting short test-only trigger windows (1 second for stall, sub-second for subprocess) into both tests while retaining real sockets and process execution reduces wall-clock runtime without altering production defaults or test semantics
ACLI read-retry test must record every real spawned PID and poll for absence after terminal failure to prove no child/process group survives cleanup
Both test files and all production timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt, and backoff defaults must remain byte-unchanged; no production code or configuration is modified
